test_title: PYST 8: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) He stretched for a moment and started his routine with some light morning exercise.
(2) The alarm went off on time, waking him up with a gentle ring.
(3) He looked at the time and programmed an alarm on his cell phone for precisely 6:00 a.m. the following day.
(4) Ensuring all was in position, he went to sleep early to have a good night's sleep.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. 3 - 4 - 2 - 1 .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a sequence of events that need to be arranged in chronological order.
 
• Step 1 (Sentence 3): The person looks at the time and programs the alarm for the next day.
 
• Step 2 (Sentence 4): They ensure everything is set and go to sleep early for a good night's rest.
 
• Step 3 (Sentence 2): The alarm goes off on time, gently waking them up.
 
• Step 4 (Sentence 1): They stretch and begin their morning routine with light exercise.

Correct sequence: *3 - 4 - 2 - 1*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tips for arranging sentences:**
 
 
• Identify the logical order of actions or events described.
 
• Focus on time-related cues such as "the following day," "wake up," and "start routine."
 
• Ensure coherence by linking actions in a cause-effect or chronological manner.
